completionSentence: 사용자는 실제로 선택한 여러 원본을 용도·미확인 사항과 함께 결과 Artifact에 결속하고, CSV·TSV의 서로 다른 열 이름을 표준 열로 취합할 때 전체 행이 원본 매핑과 정확히 일치한 결과만 받을 수 있다.
qualified: file_reality binds only exact selected handles into a private runtime-owned source manifest.
The public model surface receives source names, usage and unknowns but no absolute source paths or stored hashes.
attachment register_output revalidates every source identity and full SHA-256 before registering the result Artifact.
A changed, missing, foreign-session or malformed source manifest blocks Artifact registration.
UTF-8, UTF-16 and supported Korean legacy CSV or TSV inputs can use exact per-source column mappings into ordered output columns.
Append-row reconciliation compares the complete ordered output header and every row, not only totals or a preview sample.
The bounded verifier fails closed above 16 MiB per table or 100,000 data rows instead of claiming complete reconciliation.
Session re-entry shows a human receipt with verified source count, standardized column count and reconciled row count.

verification.transientObservation: The first daily wave stalled in the pre-existing runtime-full-stop test. That test passed alone 3/3 and the complete daily wave then passed without a product change.

notClaimed: Arbitrary semantic reconciliation for every document format
Derived business calculations that are not independently covered by the existing XLSX Artifact Quality formula contract
Unbounded or streaming tabular reconciliation beyond the stated verifier boundary
Automatic duplicate-key resolution or final-version selection
Physical Windows qualification or million-file performance qualification
